headline: There Can Be Only One
summary: Spoke Helper now stays in the background when you dictate, so your first recording no longer adds a second app to the Dock.

items.title: One Spoke in Your Dock
items.description: Fixed the extra Spoke Helper icon that appeared after the first dictation. The helper still handles paste and keyboard shortcuts, but stays out of the Dock.

headline: Smooth Operator
summary: Speech bars respond more clearly to your voice, with smoother transitions into processing. This update also reduces the wait after dictation and improves recording and paste reliability.

items.title: More Responsive Speech Bars
items.description: The original Spoke bars react more clearly to your speech. Speaking flows into a faster Bounce processing animation without an abrupt visual switch.

items.title: Cleaner Technical Dictation
items.description: Dictated acronyms, pull request references, and mixed spoken and written numbers are formatted more consistently.

items.title: Less Waiting After You Speak
items.description: Spoke finishes recording as soon as you release the shortcut. Text cleanup and paste preparation do less repeated work before your transcript is inserted.

items.title: Recording Can Start Again
items.description: Cancelled or failed recording starts no longer leave audio capture stuck in the background. Reloading the interface also releases the correct recording session.

items.title: Keep Text Available When Paste Is Delayed
items.description: Spoke waits for the receiving app to read your transcript before restoring the previous clipboard. If paste cannot be confirmed, the transcript stays available for manual paste.

headline: Keep It Local
summary: Spoke removes the remaining cloud transcription paths and opens its panel with less waiting. Longer dictations now split at pauses, with fixes for recording in the installed app.

items.title: Pause-Aware Long Dictation
items.description: Long recordings split near natural pauses instead of overlapping sections. This reduces repeated words where sections join.

items.title: A Simpler Local App
items.description: Obsolete cloud transcription, account-related setup, and screen-recording permission paths have been removed. Dictation stays on your Mac.

items.title: A Clearer Microphone Menu
items.description: Choose a microphone from a compact menu that fits the rest of Spoke’s settings.

items.title: A Faster Panel
items.description: Spoke prepares the panel while the interface is idle, so settings and history can open without waiting for the pill animation to finish.

items.title: Speech Detection in the Installed App
items.description: Fixed a problem that blocked speech detection in packaged builds, along with an audio-buffer error that could interrupt recording.

headline: Numbers, Assemble
summary: Both Parakeet and Nemotron now turn more spoken numbers and units into written forms. Parakeet becomes the recommended model, with cleaner punctuation after hesitation words are removed.

items.title: Written Numbers Across NVIDIA Models
items.description: Final transcripts from Parakeet and Nemotron format spoken numbers and units before paste. Nemotron’s live preview can still show the spoken form until dictation finishes.

items.title: Parakeet Is Recommended
items.description: Spoke now recommends Parakeet for new model choices. Existing Nemotron selections are preserved.

items.title: Steadier Nemotron Live Updates
items.description: Nemotron processes speech in longer intervals while keeping the live transcript available.

items.title: Cleaner Punctuation Around Fillers
items.description: Removing hesitation words no longer leaves stray punctuation in Parakeet transcripts.

headline: By the Numbers
summary: Parakeet transcripts now clean up common hesitation words and write clearer numbers, times, and units. Sentence starts and standalone “I” are also corrected before paste.

items.title: Cleaner Parakeet Transcripts
items.description: Common hesitation words such as “um” and “uh” are removed when they are used as fillers. Deliberately quoted or named words are kept.

items.title: Times, Percentages, and Units
items.description: Spoken times, storage sizes, percentages, and version numbers are converted to their written forms when the meaning is clear.

items.title: Sentence Capitalization
items.description: Parakeet output gets capitalized sentence starts and a capital “I” without rewriting the rest of your transcript.

headline: Less Is More
summary: Spoke does less background work while recording, displaying live text, and opening settings. History loads in smaller pages, and failed recording stops are cleaned up more reliably.

items.title: Lighter Recording and Live Text
items.description: Audio and live transcript updates reuse more of their working memory and avoid repeated interface work during dictation.

items.title: History That Loads in Smaller Pages
items.description: History loads entries as you need them instead of loading the full list at once. Off-screen rows also do less layout and animation work.

items.title: Less Startup Work
items.description: Settings tabs, model lists, and transcription features load when needed. Model progress updates no longer rely on repeated polling.

items.title: Cleaner Recording Shutdown
items.description: Failed stops release recording resources, and unfinished audio sections are discarded instead of being left pending.

headline: The Show Must Go On
summary: Dictation can continue if speech detection fails. Spoke keeps the recorded audio instead of losing the session.

items.title: Keep Dictation When Speech Detection Fails
items.description: If speech detection stops working during a recording, Spoke keeps recording and transcribes the captured audio when you finish.

headline: Live and Let Type
summary: Nemotron can now show your transcript while you speak. This update also improves model switching, live text layout, and recovery from cancelled or interrupted recordings.

items.title: Live Nemotron Transcripts
items.description: See words appear in the pill while dictating with Nemotron. Models that transcribe after recording still use the normal listening view.

items.title: More Stable Live Text
items.description: The live transcript grows line by line, with clearer spacing and a caret that follows the text without constantly shifting the whole view.

items.title: Clearer Model Switching
items.description: Model selection shows whether the chosen model is ready. Each dictation keeps the model it started with, even if you change the selection.

items.title: Saved Vocabulary for Whisper
items.description: Whisper receives your saved vocabulary as context, helping it recognize the names and terms you use.

items.title: Recover from Interrupted Starts
items.description: Cancelled model starts and interrupted streaming recordings release their resources so another dictation can begin.

headline: Loud and Clear
summary: Spoke now records through a native macOS audio helper. Microphone selection and speech-level feedback are more reliable, with improved handling of short dictations.

items.title: Native macOS Recording
items.description: Audio is captured through macOS and passed directly to local transcription. This also prepares recordings for live transcription.

items.title: Clearer Speech-Level Feedback
items.description: The listening bars are calibrated for the native microphone levels so spoken input is easier to see.

items.title: Natural Pauses in Short Dictation
items.description: Short recordings stay together, and longer recordings allow a longer natural pause before splitting.

items.title: Stable Microphone Selection
items.description: Saved microphone choices use stable device identifiers, so Spoke can find the intended microphone again.

headline: Pause for Thought
summary: Long dictations are processed in smaller sections to keep local transcription within safe limits. Notifications wait until dictation finishes instead of interrupting the pill.

items.title: Safer Long Dictation
items.description: Spoke splits long recordings into bounded sections, preferably near a pause, instead of sending one large recording to the local model. Recordings have a five-minute limit.

items.title: Notifications Can Wait
items.description: Notifications queue while you dictate, then appear after recording and processing finish.

items.title: Notification Dismissal Timing
items.description: The pill now follows the notification dismissal timing more consistently.

headline: Say My Name
summary: Saved vocabulary now recognizes multi-word phrases as well as single words. Vocabulary changes are also saved more reliably, with clearer handling when a save fails.

items.title: Multi-Word Vocabulary
items.description: Spoke can match and correct saved phrases, helping names and specialized terms retain their intended spelling.

items.title: Avoid Ambiguous Phrase Corrections
items.description: When more than one saved phrase is a close match, Spoke avoids guessing and leaves the original words in place.

items.title: Reliable Vocabulary Saves
items.description: Vocabulary edits use one shared save path. Failed saves are reported instead of silently showing an edit that was not stored.
